name: dest-flags
description: Destructable flags in war3map.doo after the editor's save: dest-tint-unref.w3x (make-dest-tint.mjs --types=LTlt,LTe1,YT04 --unref: no trigger names any destructable) given flags 0 (and 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 on seven LTlt). The editor writes 2 on every one its script doesn't create (6 where it was 4, fixed height), the script has no CreateAllDestructables; with a trigger naming them (dest-tint) it writes 0 (4 for fixed height) and creates them, whatever flags the input had (2, 3 and 6 included). So flag 2 is the editor's mark 'the game places it from the doo' and follows 'referenced or drops', it isn't input (Studio's script leaves out a destructable with flag 2 even when a trigger names it: bugs.md). Studio keeps what it is given. expectPaths names every destructable whose input flags aren't already 2 or 6 (the input's 26: flags 0 on 0-9 and 15-25, 1 on 10, 3 on 12, 4 on 13), so each one's flags must differ and the two given 2 (11) and 6 (14) must not.
